# 4 Ezra Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Signs and second dialogue

---

**5:1** Concerning-the signs: behold, the days will-come when those-who-dwell upon earth shall-be-seized-with great terror, and the way of-truth shall-be-hidden, and the land shall-be-barren of-faith.

**5:2** And iniquity shall-be-increased beyond what-you-yourself-see, and beyond what-you-heard-of-formerly.

**5:3** And the land which-you-see-now-to-rule shall-be-a trackless waste, and men shall-see-it forsaken.

**5:4** But if the-Most-High grant-you-to-live, you-shall-see it-disturbed after the-third-[period]: the sun shall-suddenly-shine at-night, and the moon during-the-day.

**5:5** And blood shall-drip from-wood, and the-stone shall-utter-its-voice; the peoples shall-be-troubled, and the-stars shall-fall.

**5:6** And a-king whom those-who-dwell upon earth do-not-expect shall-reign, and the-birds shall-fly-away.

**5:7** And the-sea of-Sodom shall-cast-up fish; and one whom-many do-not-know shall-make-his-voice-heard in-the-night; and all-shall-hear his-voice.

**5:8** There-shall-be-chaos also in-many places and fire shall-break-out-frequently, and the wild-beasts shall-wander beyond-their haunts, and women-with-child shall-bring-forth monsters.

**5:9** And fresh-water shall-be-found-in-salt, and all friends shall-vanquish-one-another; then shall-understanding-be-hidden and insight-be-withdrawn-into its-chamber,

**5:10** [it-will-be sought] by-many and shall-not-be-found, and unrighteousness and evil shall-be-multiplied upon-the-earth.

**5:11** One country shall-ask-of another: Has-righteousness passed-through-you, or-one-that-does-right? And it-shall-answer: No.

**5:12** And it-shall-be in-that-time that men-shall-hope and not-obtain; they-shall-labor and their ways-shall-not-prosper.

**5:13** These are-the signs which-I-am-permitted to-tell-you; and if-you-will-pray again, and-fast again seven days, I-will-tell-you greater things than-these.

**5:14** Then I-awoke, and my body-shuddered greatly, and my soul was-faint, for it-had-been-held by a great fearfulness; but-then the-angel who-had-come-to-speak-with me held-me and strengthened me and stood-me-on-my-feet.

**5:15** And in-the second night it-came-to-pass that Phaltiel, a-chief of-the people, came to-me and said: Where-were-you? and why-is-your-face-sad?

**5:16** Or-know-you-not that Israel has-been entrusted to-you in-the land of-their-captivity?

**5:17** Rise then and eat some bread, and abandon-not us as a-shepherd abandons his flock in-the-power of-fierce-wolves.

**5:18** Then I said to-him: Go-away from-me, and do-not-come-near me for seven days; and then come to-me and I-will-tell-you. And he departed-from-me.

**5:19** And I-fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, as-the-angel Uriel had-told-me to.

**5:20** And after seven days the thoughts of-my heart were-very-grievous to-me again,

**5:21** and my soul recovered the-spirit of-understanding, and I-began to-speak words of-prayer before-the-Most-High,

**5:22** and I said: O-LORD-above-us, from every-forest-of-the-earth and from-all its-trees you-chose one-vine;

**5:23** and from-all-the-lands of-the whole-world you-chose one region; and from-all-the-flowers-of-the-world you-chose one-lily;

**5:24** and from-all-the-depths-of-the-sea you-filled for-yourself one-river; and out-of-all-the-cities-built you-sanctified-Zion for-yourself;

**5:25** and from-all-the-birds-created you-named for-yourself one-dove; and from-all-the-flocks-made you-provided for-yourself one-sheep;

**5:26** and from-all-the-multitude-of-peoples you-acquired for-yourself one-people; and to-this-people whom-you-loved you-gave the-law which-is-approved-of by-all.

**5:27** And now, O-LORD, why-have-you-given-over the-many to-the-few, and dishonored the-one-root above-the-many, and scattered your-own among-the many nations?

**5:28** And why-have-those-who-oppose your promises trampled-them-down that-believe your covenants?

**5:29** If-you-hate so-much your-own people, they should-be-punished with your-own-hands.

**5:30** Then the-angel who-had-come to-me in-a-previous-night was-sent to-me and said to-me: Hear-me, and I-will-instruct-you; give-heed, and I-will-tell-you-more.

**5:31** And I-said: Speak, my-lord. Then-he-said to-me: Are-you greatly-troubled in-mind because-of Israel? Or-do-you-love-him-more-than-his-Maker?

**5:32** And I-said: No, my-lord, but out-of grief I-have-spoken; for my heart-pains-me every-hour while I-labor to-understand the-way of-the-Most-High and to-search-out-part of-his-judgement.

**5:33** And he-said to-me: You-cannot. And I-said: Wherefore, my-lord? for-what-purpose then-was-I-born? or-why-was my-mother's-womb not-my-tomb? and-that I-might-not-come to-see the-trouble of-Jacob and the-exhaustion of-the-race of-Israel?

**5:34** And he-said to-me: Count-for-me those-who-have-not-yet-come, and gather-for-me the-scattered-drops, and make-fragrant-for-me the-withered-flowers,

**5:35** and open-for-me the-closed-chambers, and bring-out-for-me the-winds-locked-up-therein, and show-me the-image-of-a-voice; and then I-will-show-you the-travail-that-you-ask to-see.

**5:36** And I-said: O-LORD who-rules-over-us, who-could-know these-things, except-he whose-dwelling is-not-with-men?

**5:37** But-I am-foolish; how-can-I then speak concerning-the things about-which-you-asked-me?

**5:38** And he-said to-me: Just-as-you-cannot-do one-of-the-things-mentioned, so-also are-you-not-able to-find-out my-judgement, or-the end of-the-love-I-have-promised my-people.

**5:39** And I-said: But-behold, O-LORD, you-dwell over-us, you who-are-ready and-prepared, whose compassion-is-broad and-the-nearness of-the-Highest; for in-all-things your eye-watches and in-all-things your ear-hears:

**5:40** show-then to-your-servant why your-judgement-is not by-your-right-hand.

**5:41** And he-answered-me and-said: This-age the-Most-High-made for-many but-the age-to-come for-few.

**5:42** I-will-tell-you now a-likeness, Ezra: as-when-you-ask-the earth, it-will-say to-you that it-gives-very-much-loam from-which earthenware is-made, but-little dust from-which gold-comes; so-also-is-it the-course of-the present-world.

**5:43** Then I-said: Could-you-not-have-created them-at-once, those-who-have-been and-are and shall-be, that you-might-have-shown your judgement the-sooner?

**5:44** Then he-answered-me and-said: The-creature cannot-go-faster than-the-Creator, nor can-the-world-hold all-those-who-are-created at-the-same-time.

**5:45** Then I-said: How-has-he-said to-your-servant that he-will-make-alive at-once those-who-were-created-by-you — that-those who-are-preserved in-the-earth shall-all-come-together?

**5:46** And he-said to-me: Ask-the-womb-of-a-woman: Say-to-her, If-you-bring-forth ten-children, why-do-you-do-it one-after-another? ask-her then to-bring-forth-ten-at-once.

**5:47** And I-said: That-she-cannot-do, but-only each-one-in-its-own-time.

**5:48** Then-said-he to-me: So-also have-I-given-the-womb-of-the-earth to-those who-are-sown-in-it in-their-times.

**5:49** For-as-a-young-child does-not-bring-forth and a-woman that-has-grown-old brings-forth no-more, so-I-have-ordered the-world which-I-created.

**5:50** And I-inquired and-said: Since-you-have-now-opened-the-door to-me, show-me yet-further if-more-is-to-come-after-these things. And-he-said to-me: Yes.

**5:51** And I-said: How-long? And-he-said to-me: What-the-left-hand-covers is-more-than-what-the-right-hand-covers.

**5:52** But-I prayed to-the-Most-High that-he-would-grant to-his-servant the-revelation-of-the-Holy-Spirit, and-I wrote all-things-that-I-had-seen in-a-book, which-I-placed-there-with-great-diligence.
